decisions.reason: After surviving its first review and fitting tightly with the firm's track-based core offer, this line still looks worth keeping open because it supports the system range at modest incremental cost.
As a 2024 close-to-core spotlight line with dedicated presentation, its value is still uncertain enough that management would usually keep the option alive for another year.
This canopy directly extends the firm's modular lighting system and likely has low carrying cost, so the option should be retained.
The low-voltage canopy also complements the established system architecture and planner-oriented offer, so it is still too early and too cheap to abandon.

Because this 2024 line was only lightly featured on the website and sits in a broad portfolio of other options, it looks like the weakest candidate and management would likely free resources for stronger core lines and new development.
